title: File:Snowboarder during turn while in deep powder-ColorTemp.jpeg
desc: Snowboarder leaning inwards in a curve in deep powder at high speed to counter the centrifugal force. Interesting is the small snow "pile" above the (in the image) left boot tip of the snowboarder. This is a vortex of powder snow which results from the snow gliding over the front portion of the snow
